title: Viral Short Videos Studio
description: Manifest definitions for channels, episodes, libraries and reusable recipes.

light2d.description: Scene light for layers marked lit: body shading and a rim light from one direction.

angle.description: Where the light comes from on screen, degrees (0 right, 90 top, 135 top left).

softness.description: Rim width as a fraction of the layer size.

depth.description: How round the body shading is, as a fraction of the layer size.

elevation.description: Light height: low values rake across the shape, high values light it flat.

paint.description: A hex colour or a named palette role.

ease.description: A named easing, a cubic-bezier curve, or a spring.

focus.description: Depth of field for z layers: blur grows outside z ± range.

paper.description: Static paper/print texture multiplied over the frame.

lut.description: A .cube 3D LUT: a path from the repository root or a name in presets/luts/.

leak.description: Warm light leak from the top-right corner that breathes slowly.

mood.description: Pick a track from the channel music_library by mood.

library_file.description: Set by the music expander; do not author.

beat.description: The track's beat grid for at_beat and snap. Set by the music library; author it for other files.

fit.description: Arrange a library track to the episode's length on bar lines, keeping its own opening and ending (default true).

arrangement.description: Set by the music expander; do not author.

avoid.description: Move kinetic captions off faces and caption_avoid layers (default true).

speakers.description: Kinetic captions: per-speaker text colour, or {foreground, highlight, emphasis_color}.

fonts.description: Named font roles resolved by text and caption layers.

wipe.description: Draw-on reveal: 0 hidden, 1 fully shown (see wipe_from).

turn_x.description: Perspective turn about the layer's horizontal pivot axis, in degrees.

turn_y.description: Perspective turn about the layer's vertical pivot axis, in degrees (card flips, coin spins).

bend.description: Curve the part along its length from the pivot, in degrees (rubber-hose limbs, tails). Children ride the curve.

tint_color.description: Keyable tint colour (hex) applied with tint_opacity.

fill.description: Keyed fill for rect/ellipse/polygon/text: paint or gradient (see studio/paint.py).

stroke_width.description: Keyed stroke width (same units as stroke.width).

points.description: Keyed polygon outline (0-1 box fractions); any point count morphs into any other.

z.description: Depth into the scene in screen heights; 0 is the picture plane, positive is farther.

ease_props.description: Per-property easing overrides for this keyframe.

fill.description: Solid paint or a linear/radial gradient.

turn_depth.description: How far this child sits in front of its parent's surface when the parent turns (turn_x/turn_y), as a fraction of the parent's smaller side. 0 follows the parent exactly; face features use about 0.12.

depth_photo.description: Set by make depth-photo; marks the layers of one photo split.

hero_clip.description: Set by make hero; marks the layer of one AI video clip.

fit.description: Video layers: contain (default) fits the clip inside the box; cover fills it and crops.

clip_start.description: Video layers: seconds into the clip to start from.

clip_speed.description: Video layers: playback speed (0.5 = half speed).

loop.description: Video layers: wrap to the start instead of holding the last frame.

video_fps.description: Set by the video expander; do not author.

video_frames.description: Set by the video expander; do not author.

lit.description: Shade this layer (and its children) with the shot light; a number scales it.

quiet_for.description: Hide this layer while the named speaker is talking (rest mouth).

talk_only.description: With mouth_for: show only while the speaker is talking.

rig.description: Set by defs expansion: the rig a group was built from.

paint_frames.description: Set by paint expansion: one look per sprite frame.

boil.description: Hand-drawn line wobble for SVG layers (browser renderers); 0.3-0.6 is subtle.

morph_to.description: SVG to blend into with keyable morph (same structure, different numbers/colours).

finish.description: Finish pass for SVG layers (browser renderers): cel shade, rim light, grain and outline.

outline.description: Ink line width as a fraction of the artwork size.

light.description: Direction the light comes from, [x, y]; [-1, -1] is top left.

caption_avoid.description: Kinetic captions move to keep clear of this layer.

anchor3d.description: Pin this top-level 2D layer to a 3D object's screen position (browser renderers).

occlude.description: Hide while another solid 3D object is between the camera and the anchor (default true).

ik.description: Inverse kinematics limbs solved into rotate keys (see studio/ik.py).

tip.description: End of this part (hand, foot) from its pivot in canvas fractions, in its own frame; used by ik.

motion.description: Timed motion recipes on top of the authored pose (see studio/moves.py).

alive.description: Automatic idle motion for a rig: breathe, blink, glance, sway and talk.

lipsync.description: Viseme lip sync (default when the rig has a viseme mouth set) or loudness flap (false).

command.description: Local TTS command; {out} is the WAV to write, {text} the line (with input arg).

anchor_word.description: Time this to a spoken word in the shot (studio/anchors.py): a word or phrase, or an object.

line.description: Index of the shot's speech line (0-based, negative from the end). Omit to search every line.

word.description: A word or phrase in the line's caption text, or a word index.

anchor_beat.description: Time this to the music's beat grid: a 0-based beat count, or bar and beat counted from 1.

narration.description: false: leave this line out of make narration-check (a stylised voice no recogniser hears).

pitch.description: Shift the take in semitones (-7..7) without changing its length.

pace.description: Speak faster (>1) or slower (<1); Kokoro synthesises at that speed.

intensity.description: 0-1: firmer, brighter, more forward delivery (compression and presence).

lipsync.description: false keeps this line out of automatic lip sync.

punchline.description: Hold a 0.3 s beat of silence after this line so the joke lands.

pause_after.description: Seconds of silence after this line before the next one (overrides punchline).

font.description: CSS font for flat text planes.

depth.description: Extrude text this deep (world units; letters are about 0.5 tall). 0 keeps a flat plane.

bevel.description: Rounded edge on extruded text, 0 to 1.

typeface.description: TrueType font for extruded text: a channel font role or a .ttf path. Defaults to the channel font.

morph.description: Starting GLB morph target weights by name (or index).

quality.description: high: soft 2048 shadows plus ambient occlusion, SMAA and the output pass for every shot in this scene.

poses.description: Named poses per rig: {rig: {pose: {part: {prop: value}, mouth: shape}}}.

bones.description: Bone rotation offsets in degrees [x, y, z] by bone name, on top of the rest pose or clip.

morph.description: GLB morph target weights by name (or index), e.g. {"smile": 0.8}.

ik.description: 3D IK on rigged GLB objects: bone chains reach a point or follow an object (CCD).

physics.description: Baked rigid-body motion for scene objects (see studio/physics3d.py).

colliders.description: Other scene objects that bodies hit: auto (every solid object), false, or a list of ids.

quality.description: high adds ambient occlusion, SMAA and the output pass for this shot (soft shadows come from the scene's quality).

ao.description: Ambient occlusion strength with quality high.

camera_rig.description: Generate camera keys from a named move (see studio/rig3d.py).

lights.description: Keyed light changes by light id: intensity, color, position.

ignore_3d.description: 3D objects the automatic contact check skips (decals such as mouth discs).

snap.description: Stretch the shot so it ends on the music's next beat (or next bar).

style_lock.description: Channel style lock (style-lock.json): the approved look and rules the studio enforces.

enforce.description: Refuse episodes that break the lock (default true).

rigs.description: Rig ids the cast may use.

props.description: Other rigs (props, sets) episodes may use.

source.description: Where the rigs are built from, relative to the channel.

scale_tolerance.description: Cast members sharing a shot keep the same scale within this fraction.

grades.description: Allowed post.grade looks; include "lut" to allow custom LUTs.

forbidden_paths.description: Substrings no episode asset path may contain.

exempt.description: Episodes made before the lock (by episode folder name); they render as they are.

style_exceptions.description: Approved one-off departures from the channel style lock, each with the user's reason.

poses.description: Named poses per rig: {rig: {pose: {part: {prop: value}, mouth: shape}}}.

defs.description: Named reusable layer groups for rigs, sets and props.

thumbnails.description: Optional A/B thumbnail variants. The first matching shot and text still render as thumbnail.png.
